lead_time.note: The maximum is a hidden-reply case; the range is descriptive, not a forecast.

conclusion_zh: 一手源在 10 次中全部完成确认；9 次出现某种提前信号，但只有 6 次足够清楚。社区层补回的第 10 次只是单账号低置信猜测，不能与官方排期等价。
limitations: Event-conditioned samples do not provide the full false-positive denominator for community accounts.
Lead time is not a probability and should not be extrapolated into an exact next-reset timestamp.
